programmes.d: Veronica and Wallace launch an investigation to help their new ally, Weevil. Later, Veronica learns that Lilly received a driving ticket two hours after her supposed time of death.
Veronica and Wallace try to help a classmate find his father, and Veronica's romantic interests get complicated. Plus, Duncan struggles with his sister's death.
Veronica must outwit a group of computer "thugs," Veronica introduces Keith to her new boyfriend, and Logan helps Duncan with a memorial video for the anniversary of Lilly's death.
Veronica helps her new boyfriend find his father's stolen car, but the situation turns dangerous. Plus, Veronica uncovers a secret while investigating her mother's whereabouts.
Veronica investigates fraud in the school election and Logan causes a PR nightmare for his movie star parents. Plus, Veronica and Keith further investigate Lilly's murder.
Veronica investigates the disappearance of her pregnant upstairs neighbor. Plus, Veronica learns information about her mother and Duncan's father.
Veronica searches for the culprit who released the results of a private online "purity test." Later, Veronica meets with a condemned killer to get answers about Lilly's murder.
Mars Investigations looks into a cultish group joined by a Neptune High senior. Meanwhile, Veronica attempts to dispel a claim made by a condemned killer.
Veronica investigates missing poker winnings, and Keith is hired by Lynn Echolls to track down one of the potential stalkers of her husband, Aaron.
Keith returns to the sheriff's department to help catch a serial killer, and Veronica is overwhelmed with requests for dirt on her schoolmates' parents.
George's parents are thrown upon meeting his new girlfriend, Tansy (Mircea Monroe). George's mother devises a plan forcing George and Zoe to address their feelings for one another.
When a flu epidemic heads toward BlueBell, Zoe puts the town on lockdown -- but gets jealous when Wade must stay at his ex-girlfriend's house. Lemon's plans go awry.
George panics when Tansy's (Mircea Monroe) dog goes missing on his watch. Zoe is focused on not losing her good status to a new doctor (Travis Van Winkle -- Transformers).
Wade's excited to compete in the Battle of the Bands contest, but Zoe's suggestion that George play with him backfires. Lemon and Magnolia (Claudia Lee) do some sisterly bonding.
Zoe agrees to be maid of honor for Wanda (Mallory Moye) at her wedding, which entails the difficult job of watching Wanda's mother (Debra Jo Rupp - That '70s Show).
Zoe tries to keep her feelings about Wade under control. Lavon and Wade are forced to work together at the church's casino fundraiser, but when money is missing, Wade is suspected.
Ruby Jeffries (Golden Brooks) helps out when Lavon's plans to make BlueBell a Spring Break spot hit a roadblock. George is jealous to see Zoe with Jonah (Travis Van Winkle).

To Dr. Brown's dismay, Ephram makes a bold move to raise money for a plane ticket to Europe. Meanwhile, Nina can't understand why Dr. Brown has been acting strangely lately.
Ephram prepares to leave his family and friends for a new life in Europe. Meanwhile, Nina and Jake (recurring guest star SCOTT WOLF) contemplate starting a business together.
Dr. Brown discusses with Delia the possibility of leaving Everwood to accept a prestigious position with a Chicago hospital. And Bright finally admits to Hannah that he cares for her.
After Dr. Brown's declaration of love for Nina, she must choose between the two men she loves. At Delia's behest, Ephram makes a return to Everwood just in time for an unexpected wedding.
Bright invites Ephram to move in with him and Reid. Meanwhile, Hannah worries about the long-term possibilities for her relationship with Bright.
